examSets.title: Standard Administrative Typing Exam (English Set 1)
examSets.content: Official recruitment typing assessments test candidate proficiency in speed and accuracy under strict timed conditions. Candidates are expected to maintain a minimum standard of thirty words per minute with an error rate below five percent. Pay close attention to capitalization, punctuation marks, and spacing between sentences.

examSets.title: Executive Typist Speed Assessment (English Set 2)
examSets.content: Professional data entry operators and administrative assistants are evaluated on speed consistency and error minimization. Maintaining steady rhythm and posture minimizes fatigue during high-volume document typing tests.
